facts.fact: The FDSU published a status assessment on 7 August 2026 and is developing a national strategy to expand mobile and broadband connectivity in underserved rural and peri-urban communities, where about 4.3 million people in nearly 3,000 localities lack coverage.

The FDSU runs a National Strategy for Universal Connectivity 2026-2035 to extend telecoms access in rural and peri-urban areas, with a phase 0 of 40 pilot sites and a phase 1 of about 300 sites in five zones, selected by a scoring framework.
